title: a committed .only (the rest of the suite silently stops running)
how: test files the diff touches: describe / it / test / suite .only( or an { only: true } test option

explain.what: A test file has a .only (test.only, describe.only, or { only: true }).
explain.why: With .only, the test runner runs that one test and silently skips the rest. The suite reports green while most tests did not run.
explain.fix: Delete the .only (or the only option) and run the whole file again.
